name: separator
description: Applies semantic color, orientation, and caller-provided insets to a native Divider.
usage:
Divider()
    .registrySeparator(insets: EdgeInsets(top: 0, leading: 16, bottom: 0, trailing: 16))

Divider()
    .registrySeparator(.vertical)
accessibility: Retains Divider as a noninteractive visual separator.
Uses a semantic border color that adapts to appearance.
Uses leading and trailing insets that mirror with layout direction.
Does not add redundant accessibility content.
